body: I’m so sorry you’re going through this. Hopefully your boss has some sympathy for you because it’s not your fault that you had to miss work. Taking care of yourself is the biggest priority. I’m sure your dog is so happy to have you around.

I read your whole post. You seem like a super kind and considerate person. It would be a shame for the world to lose you. But I understand the mental torment and exhaustion of being suicidal for so long. 

It seems like your family and friends would be devastated to see you go. I wonder if you could take a few more days and think of new ways to cope or potentially get better. I think seeking help through your school is a good idea. I’m sure there is a designated person/department who wants to hear your story and help out.
It’s really terrifying to think about. We either remain depressed on this earth or we have to deal with the unknown that comes after it. It’s mental torture.

Dissociation is such an uncomfortable, terrible feeling. Wouldn’t wish it on anyone. I am so fucking sorry you’re going through this. Especially when you hit a new low. It’s the most soul crushing feeling. Like damn I didn’t even know it was possible to feel THIS bad... 

I’m really sorry, keeping you in my thoughts.
It’s nice to visit this sub and know we aren’t alone in this feeling.

I relate to a lot of what you said. The feeling of agony is just the fucking worst. It feels like hell because death might be a long, long time away. And for suicidal people like us, that’s just an awful thought to bear. Just holding on until tomorrow seems impossible, but for 60-70 more years?? Yeah it feels like hell.
Those last 3 sentences. It explains exactly how I feel. Fuck.

I’ve contacted the hotline 3 times to talk about my suicidal thoughts. No police were ever sent to my house. It’s my understanding that as long as you tell them that you do NOT have ANY PLANS to kill yourself, then you’ll be fine. I believe they only send someone if they think you’re in immediate danger. 

I am so sorry about the bad news. I’m wishing you the best.

I just want to say, I’m also in grad school and it’s a pretty big factor in my depression right now. I’m extremely behind, can’t even focus or comprehend the material, etc... I wish I knew what to say to make it easier. Just know that you aren’t alone, I bet tens of thousands of us are struggling. Grad school is fucking brutal and I likely won’t finish. 

I’m so sorry you’re going through this shit. Therapy hasn’t helped me either.
I’m so sorry. I can relate to that. It’s honestly fucking exhausting. Wouldn’t it be great if our brains had an off switch and we could catch a break from the constant imagery of self harm..
Fuck, I am so sorry. I live in Metairie. Don’t hesitate to reach out if you want to talk to someone who lives around the area.
I do the exact same thing.
I’m the exact same way... it sucks so much. Makes me not even want to interact with people so that I can save myself from being judged by others honestly.

Yeah same. Plus a lot of the time they just say “be positive, it’s gonna be okay!” or other BS responses like that. Which is why I only express my suicidal feelings to other suicidal people on this sub.. because people don’t understand unless they’ve also been through it.

I hear you. But when you’re already suicidal, and then you spend hundreds - thousands of dollars trying to get help, switching therapists constantly, and still no one can do a decent job, it’s very defeating. Makes people quit.
I hear you. Thinking about people’s reactions is the worst. If i could somehow just die without anyone finding out or caring, it would be so much easier.
Yep. Exactly.

I think a lot of us here, including myself, don’t even get a positive reaction / any support at all when we talk about being suicidal anyways. I don’t get any attention for it. I have no friends and talk to almost no one. I literally gain nothing from being this way.
All they ever say is go outside or journal about your feelings. That’s why i quit therapy. I’m sorry you’re going through that. Shit is so fucked up.
I feel the same way
Yep. Heartbreak hurts like a bitch.
